confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of George Town pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately certain; the 3-star hotel anchor is the least certain because tourist-season rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine use the local beer relationship (roughly 3 to 3.7 times draft beer) because direct price knowledge is weaker. FX: the 2026-10-16 figure comes from search-result snippets attributed to the RBA exchange-rates pages and was not verified by opening the page. A third-party source gives the same 0.6947 value, but the 15 October 0.6955 figure differs slightly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Malaysian mid-sized tourist-city pricing, benchmarked against Kuala Lumpur and other Malaysian heritage destinations, adjusted for George Town's lower hotel and hostel rates and its hawker-centre food culture.
